panels.description: The newest of: the last company page read from screener.in (any company; when this one was read is in the About table), the last live candle written and the last session ingested. The prices matter because market cap, P/E, P/B and dividend yield are restated at the latest price.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT MAX(t) * 1000 AS "Last data refresh" FROM (
  SELECT MAX(fetched_at) AS t FROM company_profile
  UNION ALL SELECT MAX(updated_at) FROM live_candle
  UNION ALL SELECT MAX(ingested_at) FROM trading_day)

panels.title: $symbol - what the company does
panels.description: From the company's public page on screener.in, read by `CanSlimMain profiles` (evening.sh reads a dozen of the stalest each night, so each company is read again about once a week). **Latest results** is the last quarter the company has reported, **Shareholding as of** the last shareholding pattern filed, **Read on** the day its screener.in page was read. The links in the corner open the company on screener.in and on Candles and Calls.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT p.classification AS "Sector",
       COALESCE(p.about,
                CASE WHEN p.market_cap_cr IS NULL AND p.results_quarter IS NULL
                     THEN 'screener.in had no company figures for this symbol when it was read: an ETF or an index fund has none.'
                END) AS "About",
       substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', (CAST(substr(p.results_quarter,6,2) AS INTEGER) - 1) * 3 + 1, 3) || ' ' || substr(p.results_quarter,1,4) AS "Latest results",
       substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', (CAST(substr(p.holding_quarter,6,2) AS INTEGER) - 1) * 3 + 1, 3) || ' ' || substr(p.holding_quarter,1,4) AS "Shareholding as of",
       date(p.fetched_at, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes') AS "Read on"
FROM company_profile p
JOIN instrument i ON i.id = p.instrument_id
WHERE i.symbol = '$symbol'

panels.title: $symbol - valuation and balance sheet, at the latest price
panels.description: **Price** is the latest this database holds: today's last candle, else the last session's close. **Market cap, P/E, P/B and dividend yield** are restated at that price from the figures that do not move with it: earnings per share over the trailing twelve months, book value, the share count and the dividend per share. A loss-making company has no P/E. **Debt / equity** is borrowings over equity capital plus reserves in the latest balance sheet. **ROE, ROCE, book value and face value** are as screener.in shows them. The 52-week range is this database's own where it has one, else the page's.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT price_now                        AS "Price",
       ROUND(market_cap_now_cr)         AS "Market cap (₹ Cr)",
       ROUND(pe_now, 1)                 AS "P/E",
       ROUND(pb_now, 2)                 AS "P/B",
       ROUND(dividend_yield_now, 2)     AS "Dividend yield",
       ROUND(eps_ttm, 2)                AS "EPS (TTM)",
       ROUND(book_value, 1)             AS "Book value",
       ROUND(roe, 2)                    AS "ROE",
       ROUND(roce, 2)                   AS "ROCE",
       ROUND(debt_to_equity, 2)         AS "Debt / equity",
       ROUND(face_value, 2)             AS "Face value",
       high_52w                         AS "52-week high",
       low_52w                          AS "52-week low",
       ROUND(pct_from_52w_high, 1)      AS "From 52-week high"
FROM v_company_fundamentals
WHERE symbol = '$symbol'

panels.title: $symbol - growth and margin
panels.description: The first four are compounded growth as screener.in prints it: over the trailing twelve months, and per year over three years. The **Quarter** figures are the latest reported quarter (see *Latest results* above) against the same quarter a year earlier, and its net profit as a share of revenue. A year-on-year figure is blank when the year-earlier one was zero or a loss, because a percentage of it means nothing. Red below zero, green above.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT f.sales_growth_ttm  AS "Revenue growth (TTM)",
       f.sales_growth_3y   AS "Revenue growth (3Y CAGR)",
       f.profit_growth_ttm AS "Profit growth (TTM)",
       f.profit_growth_3y  AS "Profit growth (3Y CAGR)",
       ROUND(CASE WHEN y.sales > 0 THEN (q.sales / y.sales - 1) * 100 END, 1)                AS "Quarter revenue, YoY",
       ROUND(CASE WHEN y.net_profit > 0 THEN (q.net_profit / y.net_profit - 1) * 100 END, 1) AS "Quarter profit, YoY",
       ROUND(CASE WHEN q.sales > 0 THEN q.net_profit * 100.0 / q.sales END, 1)              AS "Quarter net margin"
FROM v_company_fundamentals f
LEFT JOIN company_quarter q
  ON q.instrument_id = f.instrument_id
 AND q.period = (SELECT MAX(x.period) FROM company_quarter x WHERE x.instrument_id = f.instrument_id)
LEFT JOIN company_quarter y
  ON y.instrument_id = q.instrument_id AND y.period = strftime('%Y-%m', q.period || '-01', '-12 months')
WHERE f.symbol = '$symbol'

panels.title: $symbol - revenue and net profit by quarter (₹ crore)
panels.description: The latest eight reported quarters, from screener.in. Revenue is the "Sales" line (a bank's "Revenue"); net profit is after tax.

targets.rawQueryText:

       q.sales      AS "Revenue",
       q.net_profit AS "Net profit"
FROM company_quarter q
JOIN instrument i ON i.id = q.instrument_id
WHERE i.symbol = '$symbol'
ORDER BY q.period

panels.title: $symbol - quarterly results, newest first
panels.description: **YoY** compares a quarter with the same quarter a year earlier, which takes out the seasons; **QoQ** with the quarter just before. Only the eight latest quarters are read, so the oldest four have no year-earlier quarter to compare with. A change is blank when the earlier figure was zero or a loss, because a percentage of it means nothing.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', (CAST(substr(q.period,6,2) AS INTEGER) - 1) * 3 + 1, 3) || ' ' || substr(q.period,1,4) AS "Quarter",
       q.sales      AS "Revenue (₹ Cr)",
       q.net_profit AS "Net profit (₹ Cr)",
       ROUND(CASE WHEN q.sales > 0 THEN q.net_profit * 100.0 / q.sales END, 2)             AS "Net margin",
       q.eps        AS "EPS (₹)",
       ROUND(CASE WHEN y.sales > 0 THEN (q.sales / y.sales - 1) * 100 END, 2)                AS "Revenue YoY",
       ROUND(CASE WHEN y.net_profit > 0 THEN (q.net_profit / y.net_profit - 1) * 100 END, 2) AS "Profit YoY",
       ROUND(CASE WHEN y.eps > 0 THEN (q.eps / y.eps - 1) * 100 END, 2)                      AS "EPS YoY",
       ROUND(CASE WHEN p.sales > 0 THEN (q.sales / p.sales - 1) * 100 END, 2)                AS "Revenue QoQ",
       ROUND(CASE WHEN p.net_profit > 0 THEN (q.net_profit / p.net_profit - 1) * 100 END, 2) AS "Profit QoQ"
FROM company_quarter q
JOIN instrument i ON i.id = q.instrument_id
LEFT JOIN company_quarter y
  ON y.instrument_id = q.instrument_id AND y.period = strftime('%Y-%m', q.period || '-01', '-12 months')
LEFT JOIN company_quarter p
  ON p.instrument_id = q.instrument_id AND p.period = strftime('%Y-%m', q.period || '-01', '-3 months')
WHERE i.symbol = '$symbol'
ORDER BY q.period DESC
targets.queryText:
SELECT substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', (CAST(substr(q.period,6,2) AS INTEGER) - 1) * 3 + 1, 3) || ' ' || substr(q.period,1,4) AS "Quarter",
       q.sales      AS "Revenue (₹ Cr)",

LEFT JOIN company_quarter p

WHERE i.symbol = '$symbol'

panels.title: $symbol - who holds the shares (% of shares)
panels.description: The shareholding pattern at the end of each of the last eight quarters, from screener.in: promoters, foreign institutions (FII), domestic institutions (DII, mutual funds and insurers among them), the public, and the government and other holders together, so a bar adds up to 100.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', (CAST(substr(h.period,6,2) AS INTEGER) - 1) * 3 + 1, 3) || ' ' || substr(h.period,1,4) AS "Quarter",
       h.promoters AS "Promoters",
       h.fiis      AS "FII",
       h.diis      AS "DII",
       h.public    AS "Public",
       CASE WHEN h.government IS NULL AND h.others IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE COALESCE(h.government, 0) + COALESCE(h.others, 0) END AS "Government and others"
FROM company_holding h
JOIN instrument i ON i.id = h.instrument_id
WHERE i.symbol = '$symbol'
ORDER BY h.period
targets.queryText:

       h.public    AS "Public",

            ELSE COALESCE(h.government, 0) + COALESCE(h.others, 0) END AS "Government and others"
FROM company_holding h

panels.title: $symbol - change in holdings over the last quarter
panels.description: The latest shareholding pattern against the one quarter earlier. Promoters, FII, DII and public are in **percentage points** of the shares (63.8% from 66.4% is -2.6); shareholders is the **percent** change in their number. The colour shows only the direction: green up, red down. Blank when that earlier quarter is not among the eight read.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ROUND(h.promoters - e.promoters, 2) AS "Promoters",
       ROUND(h.fiis - e.fiis, 2)           AS "FII",
       ROUND(h.diis - e.diis, 2)           AS "DII",
       ROUND(h.public - e.public, 2)       AS "Public",
       ROUND(CASE WHEN e.shareholders > 0 THEN (h.shareholders / e.shareholders - 1) * 100 END, 1) AS "Shareholders"
FROM company_holding h
JOIN instrument i ON i.id = h.instrument_id
LEFT JOIN company_holding e
  ON e.instrument_id = h.instrument_id AND e.period = strftime('%Y-%m', h.period || '-01', '-3 months')
WHERE i.symbol = '$symbol'
  AND h.period = (SELECT MAX(x.period) FROM company_holding x WHERE x.instrument_id = h.instrument_id)

panels.title: Every company with a screener.in profile: $symbol, then its peers, then the rest
panels.description:
One row per company whose screener.in page has been read, at the latest price. **Peer**: *same industry* shares the first two levels of screener.in's classification with the symbol picked (say Financial Services › Banks), *same sector* only the first; within each, the largest first. Click a symbol to show it on this page, a column header to sort, the filter icon on Industry to narrow the list.

**Mkt cap** market capitalisation in ₹ crore; **D/E** debt to equity; **Rev 3Y, Profit 3Y** screener.in's compounded growth per year over three years; **Rev YoY, Profit YoY** the latest reported quarter against the same quarter a year earlier (blank when that was zero or a loss); **Margin** its net profit as a share of revenue; **Promoters** their holding in the latest shareholding pattern; **vs 52w high** how far the latest price is from the 52-week high.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT f.*,
         substr(f.classification, 1, instr(f.classification || ' › ', ' › ') - 1) AS sector,
         substr(substr(f.classification, instr(f.classification || ' › ', ' › ') + 3), 1,
                instr(substr(f.classification, instr(f.classification || ' › ', ' › ') + 3) || ' › ', ' › ') - 1)
           AS industry_group,
         trim(replace(f.classification, rtrim(f.classification, replace(f.classification, '›', '')), '')) AS industry
  FROM v_company_fundamentals f
  WHERE f.market_cap_now_cr IS NOT NULL OR f.results_quarter IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT c.symbol AS "Symbol",
       CASE WHEN c.symbol = s.symbol THEN 'selected'
            WHEN c.sector = s.sector AND c.industry_group = s.industry_group AND c.industry_group <> ''
              THEN 'same industry'
            WHEN c.sector = s.sector AND c.sector <> '' THEN 'same sector'
       END AS "Peer",
       c.industry                        AS "Industry",
       ROUND(c.market_cap_now_cr)        AS "Mkt cap ₹ Cr",
       ROUND(c.pe_now, 1)                AS "P/E",
       ROUND(c.pb_now, 2)                AS "P/B",
       ROUND(c.roe, 1)                   AS "ROE",
       ROUND(c.roce, 1)                  AS "ROCE",
       ROUND(c.debt_to_equity, 2)        AS "D/E",
       c.sales_growth_3y                 AS "Rev 3Y",
       c.profit_growth_3y                AS "Profit 3Y",
       ROUND(CASE WHEN y.sales > 0 THEN (q.sales / y.sales - 1) * 100 END, 1)                AS "Rev YoY",
       ROUND(CASE WHEN y.net_profit > 0 THEN (q.net_profit / y.net_profit - 1) * 100 END, 1) AS "Profit YoY",
       ROUND(CASE WHEN q.sales > 0 THEN q.net_profit * 100.0 / q.sales END, 1)              AS "Margin",
       h.promoters                       AS "Promoters",
       ROUND(c.pct_from_52w_high, 1)     AS "vs 52w high"
FROM c
LEFT JOIN c s ON s.symbol = '$symbol'
LEFT JOIN company_quarter q
  ON q.instrument_id = c.instrument_id
 AND q.period = (SELECT MAX(x.period) FROM company_quarter x WHERE x.instrument_id = c.instrument_id)
LEFT JOIN company_quarter y
  ON y.instrument_id = q.instrument_id AND y.period = strftime('%Y-%m', q.period || '-01', '-12 months')
LEFT JOIN company_holding h
  ON h.instrument_id = c.instrument_id
 AND h.period = (SELECT MAX(x.period) FROM company_holding x WHERE x.instrument_id = c.instrument_id)
ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.symbol = s.symbol THEN 0

              WHEN c.sector = s.sector AND c.sector <> '' THEN 2
              ELSE 3 END,
         c.market_cap_now_cr DESC

WITH c AS (
  SELECT f.*,
         substr(f.classification, 1, instr(f.classification || ' › ', ' › ') - 1) AS sector,
         substr(substr(f.classification, instr(f.classification || ' › ', ' › ') + 3), 1,
                instr(substr(f.classification, instr(f.classification || ' › ', ' › ') + 3) || ' › ', ' › ') - 1)
           AS industry_group,
         trim(replace(f.classification, rtrim(f.classification, replace(f.classification, '›', '')), '')) AS industry
  FROM v_company_fundamentals f
  WHERE f.market_cap_now_cr IS NOT NULL OR f.results_quarter IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT c.symbol AS "Symbol",
       CASE WHEN c.symbol = s.symbol THEN 'selected'
            WHEN c.sector = s.sector AND c.industry_group = s.industry_group AND c.industry_group <> ''
              THEN 'same industry'
            WHEN c.sector = s.sector AND c.sector <> '' THEN 'same sector'
       END AS "Peer",
       c.industry                        AS "Industry",
       ROUND(c.market_cap_now_cr)        AS "Mkt cap ₹ Cr",
       ROUND(c.pe_now, 1)                AS "P/E",
       ROUND(c.pb_now, 2)                AS "P/B",
       ROUND(c.roe, 1)                   AS "ROE",
       ROUND(c.roce, 1)                  AS "ROCE",
       ROUND(c.debt_to_equity, 2)        AS "D/E",
       c.sales_growth_3y                 AS "Rev 3Y",
       c.profit_growth_3y                AS "Profit 3Y",
       ROUND(CASE WHEN y.sales > 0 THEN (q.sales / y.sales - 1) * 100 END, 1)                AS "Rev YoY",
       ROUND(CASE WHEN y.net_profit > 0 THEN (q.net_profit / y.net_profit - 1) * 100 END, 1) AS "Profit YoY",
       ROUND(CASE WHEN q.sales > 0 THEN q.net_profit * 100.0 / q.sales END, 1)              AS "Margin",
       h.promoters                       AS "Promoters",
       ROUND(c.pct_from_52w_high, 1)     AS "vs 52w high"
FROM c
LEFT JOIN c s ON s.symbol = '$symbol'
